metadata.title: ServiceNow Earnings: AI Disruption Concerns Shadow NOW Stock<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
ServiceNow Stock at a Crossroads: Why AI Concerns Dominate This Earnings Report
ServiceNow will report its second-quarter earnings on Wednesday afternoon in a troubled time for software companies. Though analyst projections for the next couple of years are still pretty rosy, ServiceNow is one of the firms at the center of the software-stock meltdown, with its shares down 47% in the past year.
